meta.name: letter-senses-freeze
meta.description: Version tag and content lock for letter_senses.csv. The letter dataset is FROZEN while roots are being curated: a root that finds no match is a RESULT to record, never a reason to edit a letter.
policy: The letter dataset does not move during a root-curation batch.
A root with no eligible sense is recorded as an unmatched result; no letter is retouched to make it fit.
A letter may change ONLY through a new version here, justified by a letter-level authority with a page — never by a root that did not work.
scripts/build_root_cores_seed.py must never read or write letter_senses.csv.
meta.digest_note: sha256 over the RAW BYTES of letter_senses.csv. Reformatting trips it too, and that is intended: a curated dataset does not get touched by accident.

history.reason: Initial freeze, taken at the end of the constrain-lisan-by-root-core change and before any further root curation. 59 senses over the 28 base letters.
history.source: حسن عباس، خصائص الحروف العربية ومعانيها (1998) — every row page-cited; see the per-row `source` and `page` columns.

history.reason: Merged the sheet's only duplicate. `masha-medial` and `masha-final` carried an identical gloss and identical axes for ح, differing only in `position` — one statement of the author transcribed twice, not two uses. He states it once, over two positions at once: «في الآخر والوسط: تغلب المشاعر الإنسانية والأصوات والرقة والصفاء مع الحرارة والميل». The merged row `masha` therefore carries `position: medial;final`, which is also why `position` became a `;`-separated set: `any` would contradict the different «في الأول» he states separately, and two rows keep the duplicate. No other row changed.
history.source: حسن عباس، خصائص الحروف العربية ومعانيها، ص 180-189 (position_notes de ح dans arabic_letter_semantics_hasan_abbas.json)
